messages.author: ba46e0c634632e6f
messages.subject: rstan warmup samples
parts: From reading the docs/watching the sampling output, my understanding is that rstan obtains iter number of samples (all of which are saved), with warmup number of those used for adapting the sampler. If this assumption is correct, how do I ignore the warmup samples that are saved when making inference (say for something as basic as printing the summary of the fit)? And is it possible to have rstan simply not save these warmup iterations?

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan warmup samples
parts:
In RStan, all are saved. But the warmup samples are not used for summary and print.

Now, there is no option not to save the warmup iterations. However, the extract function can get draws without warmup by specifying inc_warmup = FALSE.

Jiqiang
